summary: Glossary: JSON, credential metadata, nodes (controller_node vs execution_node) and node types Control, Hybrid, Hop and Execution, plus notification templates and notifications.
questions: What is the difference between control, hybrid, hop and execution nodes?

answer_card.title: Node types
answer_card.answer_md:
| Type | Role |
|---|---|
| Control | Runs persistent services and delegates jobs to hybrid and execution nodes |
| Hybrid | Runs persistent services and runs jobs |
| Hop | Relays traffic across the mesh only |
| Execution | Runs jobs delivered from control nodes |

In the jobs API, `execution_node` is where the job ran and `controller_node` is the node that managed it.
